summary: Removing one access in a review really removes it, and the Manager stays responsive.

fixes.title: Removing one access in a review works
fixes.text: In the previous version, removing one access in a review left the membership in the tenant. Once committed, PIM Manager now removes exactly that membership.
fixes.action: If you committed a one-access removal with version 2.4.453, remove it again, or use Delete on the Drift page.

fixes.title: The Manager stays responsive
fixes.text: The permission check on Overview is now reused for five minutes instead of running on every visit, so other pages no longer wait. Verify permissions still checks at once.

fixes.title: Faster audit trail and Pending changes
fixes.text: The audit trail prepares its summaries only for entries on screen, and Pending changes no longer holds up a commit.

fixes.title: Fewer slow-downs on large reads
fixes.text: When Microsoft asks PIM Manager to slow down, it now pauses between batches, so large drift reads finish with far fewer retries.
